title: Sitaare Zameen Par
desc: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.

title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.

title: Ishqbaaz Khiladi
desc: A middle-aged tech worker faces many failed relationships. However, he refuses to give up on love and starts a new quest for his perfect match.

title: The Mummy Returns
desc: An Egyptologist is caught in the crossfire when a sinister cult resurrects the mummified body of an evil priest. The group then aims to use his ancient power to defeat a legendary warrior.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
desc: A couple's intense love story sparks a journey of healing and profound transformation.

title: MLA Ka Power
desc: A simple man falls for a rich landlord's daughter and in order to prove his love and marry her, he must become an MLA and succeed.

title: Darling
desc: Raghav's marriage plans are disrupted by his wife's multiple personalities. However, he grows through this experience, learns about love and finds unexpected joy in life.

title: Connect
desc: Susan, the mother of Anna, a teenage girl, seeks virtual help from a pastor to perform an exorcism through an online video call.
